_comment: MISSION GRAPHS — authored BEFORE rooms, validated by tools/verify-graphs.mjs
(playbook §4/§11). One entry per region; regions are added here as their
reward|boss|connector|safe. beat: ki|sho|ten|ketsu for teaching rooms.
the wolf IS the dungeon item, granted at the end, with the region's
scorched/cracked/bramble promise-gates as its >=3 dormant affordances,
recontextualizing on the walk back. Each region ALSO carries a non-wolf
MID-REGION DISCOVERY as the second item beat. Density scales by region:
L1-L3 kid-weighted (3 required puzzles), L4-L7 full (5-6). Blocks snap
to the grid; the player never does.

ember_hollow.item_note: A carried socket-stone found mid-region (lc1). Carrying it disables the special (the Wild Arms trade). Three sockets exist; only the boss-door socket is required, the others are refundable treats — the stone can always be taken back, so no ferrying softlock.

nodes.note: one block, one plate, opens the door; no enemies, cannot fail
two blocks, two plates, a corner to think about; combat cleared first, then the puzzle (KID rule)
OPTIONAL twist: block pushed across geyser lanes — push only while they rest. Reward chest + scorched gate (dormant #2)
the Causeway: geysers telegraph a full cycle before they can hurt (L9), moths overhead
mini-encounter, then THE EMBERSTONE. Pip teaches carry: held overhead, special disabled while borne
socket: spending the stone here opens the shortcut back to la (closes the cycle). Refundable.
the Gutter Dam: a block pushed into the lava channel cools the crossing; the Emberstone seats in the boss-door socket. No new information.
POST-BOSS: the four-brazier order room (needs fire_slam — dormant #3). Dark; dark_sight reads the order rings.
the Shadowgrip -> FIRE WOLF. Walk-back recontext: scorched gates in la, lb2 and the firePromise gates burn open (>=3 dormant affordances)

edges.note: the shortcut socket — optional, closes the cycle
the boss-door socket — the required spend
